title: IDF Confirms Killing of Hamas Nukhba Fighter Ismail Qandil, Tied to Oct. 7 Killing of Nahal Brigade Commander
detail: The IDF announced on September 10, 2026 that it had killed Ismail Ibrahim Darwish Qandil, a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force, in a strike near Khan Younis in southern Gaza roughly three days earlier (around September 7). The military said Qandil infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7, 2023 attack and took part in the killing of Nahal Brigade commander Col. Yonatan Steinberg, and that he had more recently been advancing attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and working to rebuild Hamas's military capabilities in violation of the October 2025 ceasefire. No Palestinian or Hamas confirmation of the strike or Qandil's role was available at time of reporting.

confidenceReason: Based solely on an IDF announcement reported by Israeli outlets days after the strike reportedly occurred; no independent Palestinian confirmation of the target's identity, date, or circumstances was available.

title: Israeli Strikes and Fire Kill 1, Wound 30 Across Gaza in 24 Hours; Post-Ceasefire Toll Reaches 1,359
detail: Israeli strikes, drone fire and gunfire hit multiple locations across Gaza over September 9-10, 2026, according to Palestinian medical sources and Gaza's Civil Defence. An airstrike hit a residential block in the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, with several casualties -- mostly children -- taken to Al-Awda Hospital. In Khan Younis, a strike on the Abu Hatab family home injured a young man and an elderly man, while quadcopter fire in the Al-Mahatta neighborhood critically wounded a child in the neck (taken to Nasser Hospital), and an aircraft bombing near the Jordanian Field Hospital caused further injuries. In Jabalia, helicopter fire and artillery struck east of the refugee camp, and a woman was shot and injured in the Halawa area. In Gaza City, an airstrike on a residential building in Shati refugee camp injured a girl, drone strikes at the Abu 'Elba roundabout near Sheikh Radwan critically injured two Palestinians, and a woman was moderately wounded by gunfire in the Zarqa area. Gaza's Ministry of Health said the cumulative overall toll since October 7, 2023 rose to 73,670 killed and 174,682 wounded, while the toll since the October 11, 2025 ceasefire reached 1,359 killed, 4,571 injured and 831 bodies recovered from rubble, with 1 fatality and 30 wounded recorded in the preceding 24 hours.

title: Israel Detains 100+ Palestinians Across West Bank in a Week, Including 15 in Six-Hour Burqa Raid
detail: Israeli forces detained more than 100 Palestinians across the West Bank in the week leading up to September 10, 2026, according to WAFA and the Palestinian Prisoner's Society, bringing the total detained in the West Bank since October 2023 to over 25,000. In a pre-dawn raid on Thursday, September 10, soldiers stormed the town of Burqa (northwest of Nablus) for roughly six hours, raiding homes and arresting 15 residents before withdrawing; Burqa has been repeatedly targeted by settlers and soldiers in recent weeks, including home demolitions. Separate raids detained more than 20 people in the Arroub refugee camp south of Bethlehem over alleged attack planning, while other operations were reported in Azzun (east of Qalqilya) and Beitunia (near Ramallah), and a home was demolished in Battir, west of Bethlehem. Detainees named in reporting included former prisoner Ahmad al-Sayfi of Birzeit and journalists Muath Amarneh and Sabri Jibril. The Palestinian Prisoner's Society documented allegations of field interrogations, physical assaults and property damage during the raids; Israeli authorities did not respond to the specific allegations in available coverage.
